entries.72b12d083757f62d: Since its founding in 1935, the company has built its foundation as a manufacturer on its corporate motto, "Technology Must Be Correct," and its basic management philosophy is to constantly pursue cutting-edge technology and contribute to society by making precise and valuable products. As a "comprehensive abrasive processing machine manufacturer" in both machine tools and semiconductor-related equipment, it leverages management resources including technological development, production capacity and sales capabilities to advance its global business operations.
